about: OOsh is a D2C brand that sells everyday body essentials.
description: {name} case study: a Shopify storefront for a body essentials range, from homepage to product page on desktop and mobile, with matching Meta and Google Ads.
brief: {name} sells everyday body essentials. This page covers a Shopify storefront, from the homepage through to a product detail page on desktop and mobile, together with the Meta and Google Ads that point at it.
The storefront, the ads and the social creative share one look, so an ad and the page it points to read as the same brand.

showcases.title: Homepage and product listing, with a mobile product page
showcases.text: A calm, product-first homepage with the range listed beneath the hero, and a phone-sized product page with colour choice, add to bag and expandable details.

showcases.title: A Meta ad and a Google ad
showcases.text: Both ads reuse the product photography and the soft palette of the storefront, so the click lands on a page that looks like the ad.

showcases.title: The products behind the pages
showcases.text: Product photography from the same artwork.
